==Instructions==
This section describes how you implement <tt>archivedate</tt>, <tt>archiveurl</tt>, <tt>archivefile</tt>, and <tt>nobackup</tt> in citation templates.

<pre><nowiki>
{{#if:{{{archivedate|}}} <!-- START LEVEL 1-->
    |&nbsp;([https://web.archive.org/web/{{{archivedate}}}/URL-PARAMETER-OF-TEMPLATE backup link])
    |{{#if:{{{3|{{{archiveurl|}}}}}} <!-- START LEVEL 2 -->
        |&nbsp;([{{{3|{{{archiveurl}}}}}} backup link])
        |{{#if:{{{nobackup|}}} <!-- START LEVEL 3 -->
            |&nbsp;(backup link not available)
            |&nbsp;([https://web.archive.org/web/URL-PARAMETER-OF-TEMPLATE backup link] [[Template:TEMPLATE-NAME|<span style="color: red">'''not verified!'''</span>]]){{#if:{{NAMESPACE}} <!-- START LEVEL 4 -->
                |{{#ifeq:{{NAMESPACE}} <!-- START LEVEL 5 -->
                    |File
                    |[[Category:Pages with missing permanent archival links]]
                    |
                 }} <!-- END LEVEL 5 -->
                |[[Category:Pages with missing permanent archival links]]
             }} <!-- END LEVEL 4 -->
         }} <!-- END LEVEL 3 -->
     }} <!-- END LEVEL 2 -->
}} <!-- END LEVEL 1 -->
</nowiki></pre>

===Explanation===
*'''Level 1''': check for <tt>archivedate</tt>
**if <tt>archivedate</tt> is provided, render link to IA using the URL and the timestamp
**if <tt>archivedate</tt> is not provided, proceed to '''Level 2''': check for <tt>archiveurl</tt>
***if <tt>archiveurl</tt> is provided, render link to archive
***if <tt>archiveurl</tt> is not provided, proceed to '''Level 3''': check for <tt>nobackup</tt>
****if <tt>nobackup</tt> is provided, render <small>(backup link not available)</small>
****if <tt>nobackup</tt> is not provided, render <small>([https://web.archive.org/web/URL-PARAMETER-OF-TEMPLATE backup link] [[Template:BackupLinkHelp|<span style="color: red">'''not verified!'''</span>]])</small>, and proceed to '''Level 4''':
*****if <tt><nowiki>{{NAMESPACE}}</nowiki></tt> is empty (if we're in mainspace), add maintenance category
*****if <tt><nowiki>{{NAMESPACE}}</nowiki></tt> is not empty, proceed to '''Level 5''':
******if <tt><nowiki>{{NAMESPACE}}</nowiki></tt> equals "File", add maintenance category
******if <tt><nowiki>{{NAMESPACE}}</nowiki></tt> does not equal "File", do nothing
